description: One-call KYB report on a Japanese corporation: official registry record, lifecycle status (active/closed), kana + romaji name readings, machine-actionable risk flags, an English summary, and the dataset vintage. Accepts a 13-digit corporate number or a company name. Premium composite ($0.25) — replaces 3-4 separate lookups.

city.description: Optional city/ward filter for name resolution.

corporate_number.description: 13-digit corporate number (法人番号). Either this or name is required.

name.description: Company trade name when the number is unknown.

prefecture.description: Optional prefecture filter for name resolution.

name: houjin_kyb_report
